Clozapine: ANC monitoring, met labs, CRP/eosinophils/troponin
Second-generation antipsychotics: FBG, HbA1c, lipids, BMI after starting or a dose Δ
Risperidone: met monitoring (FBG, HbA1c, lipids); hyperprolactinemia
Anorexia nervosa: lab and other findings
EToH: GGT, AST:ALT >2, LDH, CDT, MCV
Neuroleptic malig syndrome: CK >1000 IU/L, leukocytosis
Ziprasidone: highest QT risk; EKG after dose increases, stop if QT >500 ms
TCAs: QT prolongation, torsades (sodium bicarb), OD
Lithium: baseline EKG; brady, abnorm T waves

Alzheimer dz: MRI diffuse cortical atrophy
